title: Night of the Living Dead
plot_overview: A woman fleeing a cemetery attack takes refuge in an isolated farmhouse, where she joins a group of strangers fighting to survive as flesh-eating ghouls gather outside. With radio and television reports revealing the crisis is spreading, fear and disagreements threaten the group from within.

title: His Girl Friday
plot_overview: A sharp newspaper reporter plans to leave journalism and marry her dependable fiancé, but her clever, manipulative ex-husband and editor has other ideas. As a major local story unfolds, he uses her irresistible love of news to pull her back into the frantic newsroom.

title: Plan 9 from Outer Space
plot_overview: In California, an old man and his recently buried wife are brought back to life by visitors from space. As flying saucers appear over Hollywood and Washington, a group including military, police, and civilians confronts an alien plan involving the dead.

title: House on Haunted Hill
plot_overview: A wealthy host invites five strangers to spend the night in a reportedly haunted house, offering each a large cash reward for staying until morning. As unsettling incidents unfold and the guests receive guns for protection, they must decide whether the danger comes from ghosts, the house, or someone among them.

title: Charade
plot_overview: After her husband is murdered, a recently widowed woman learns that his past involved stolen money and dangerous former accomplices. As she searches for answers in Paris, she is drawn into a tense, flirtatious game of deception with a charming stranger whose story keeps changing.

title: Carnival of Souls
plot_overview: After surviving a deadly car accident, a church organist relocates to Utah for a fresh start. Her life becomes increasingly unsettled by visions of a sinister figure and an abandoned carnival that seems to draw her closer, raising unsettling questions about what happened to her and where she belongs.

title: Metropolis
plot_overview: In a futuristic city divided between wealthy citizens above and laborers below, a privileged young man is shaken by the workers’ harsh lives. After meeting a woman who speaks of a coming mediator, he becomes caught between the city’s ruling power and growing unrest.

title: The General
plot_overview: During the Civil War, a determined railroad engineer pursues his stolen locomotive after the woman he loves is taken along with it. His effort leads him into enemy territory, where he relies on ingenuity, physical courage, and relentless determination to recover both the train and his beloved.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
plot_overview: A masked figure haunts the Paris Opera House, manipulating performances and terrorizing those who challenge his influence. Beneath the theater, he draws a promising young singer into his secluded world while her affection remains divided between ambition, devotion, and another man.

title: Nosferatu
plot_overview: A real estate agent travels to a remote castle in the Transylvanian mountains to finalize a house purchase with a mysterious count. As the count prepares to leave for the agent’s town, an ominous threat begins to spread, drawing the agent and his wife into a terrifying struggle.
